adjudication.rationale: In the new component `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but does not attach a `.catch(popupAjaxError)` (unlike `save()`, which does). Since `destroyRecord()` returns a promise, a failure (e.g., server error, concurrent deletion) would result in an unhandled rejection and no user-visible error handling, leaving the UI in an inconsistent/silent-failure state.
